record.paper_title: A Short Note on some open problems in the geometry of operator ideals
record.context_brief: Normed product ideal with L2 factor
record.original_question: Does the product ideal (L1 ◦ L∞)** ◦ L2 admit an ideal norm? Equivalently, is the product ideal (L1 ◦ L∞)** ◦ L2 normed?

evidence.quote: Here is a nice application of Theorem 2.3: Put A := (L1 ◦ L∞)∗∗. Due to Grothendieck’s inequality in operator form, it follows that L2 ⊆ A∗ ... Hence, in view of Theorem 2.3, a natural question appears:
Problem 2.4 Is the product ideal (L1 ◦ L∞)∗∗ ◦ L2 normed?
However, we do not know criteria which are sufficient for the existence of an ideal-norm on a given product of quasi-Banach ideals.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathfrak{L}_p$ ($1\le p\le \infty$) denote the Banach operator ideal of absolutely $p$-summing operators between Banach spaces, equipped with its natural ideal norm. For a quasi-Banach operator ideal $\mathfrak{A}$, let $\mathfrak{A}^{**}$ denote its bidual (regular hull / second dual ideal). For two quasi-Banach operator ideals $\mathfrak{A}$ and $\mathfrak{B}$, the product ideal $\mathfrak{A}\circ\mathfrak{B}$ consists of all bounded operators $T$ between Banach spaces that admit a factorization $T=AB$ with $B\in\mathfrak{B}$ and $A\in\mathfrak{A}$.

Set $\mathfrak{A}:=(\mathfrak{L}_1\circ\mathfrak{L}_\infty)^{**}$. By Grothendieck's inequality (in operator form) one has $\mathfrak{L}_2\subseteq\mathfrak{A}^*$ (the adjoint ideal of $\mathfrak{A}$).

Question: Does the product operator ideal
$$(\mathfrak{L}_1\circ\mathfrak{L}_\infty)^{**}\circ\mathfrak{L}_2$$
admit an ideal norm — that is, is this product ideal a normed (Banach) operator ideal?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search surfaces the related work "On normed products of operator ideals which contain L_2 as a factor" by F. Oertel (arXiv:math/0108123), which discusses exactly such product ideals and the question of whether they are normed, but no source found resolves the specific question of whether $(\mathfrak{L}_1\circ\mathfrak{L}_\infty)^{**}\circ\mathfrak{L}_2$ admits an ideal norm. No published resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: On normed products of operator ideals which contain L_2 as a factor
status_evidence.snippet: Studies quasi-Banach operator ideal products A ∘ B which contain L_2 as a factor and conditions guaranteeing the product is a normed (Banach) ideal.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related framework but does not explicitly settle whether $(\mathfrak{L}_1\circ\mathfrak{L}_\infty)^{**}\circ\mathfrak{L}_2$ is normed.
